COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Emerging Technologies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Technologies.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Technologies.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Technologies.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Technologies.

2. When learning Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.

3. When learning Data Analysis and Visualisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Data Analysis and Visualisation.

4. When learning Cybersecurity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cybersecurity.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cybersecurity.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cybersecurity.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cybersecurity.

5. When learning Social and Ethical Issues in Networking, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

9. When learning Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.

10. When learning Cloud Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cloud Computing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Cloud Computing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cloud Computing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cloud Computing.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

12. When learning Career Opportunities, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Web Development II and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Software Development Life Cycle and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Software Project Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Technologies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
